# @coodiepee/grspec
<!-- Generated by grspec v0.5.1. Edit freely. -->

AI-native system for spec-driven development — vibe coding framework

Tech stack: TypeScript · Node >=20.19.0 · Vitest · pnpm

## Commands

- `pnpm run build` — build
- `pnpm run test` — test
- `pnpm run lint` — lint
- `pnpm run dev` — dev

## Architecture

```
src/
  cli/
  commands/
  core/
  prompts/
  telemetry/
  ui/
  utils/
```

## Code Style

- Names: self-documenting, no generic placeholders (`data`, `info`, `tmp`, `result`)
- Functions: one abstraction level per function, describable in one sentence without "and"
- Abstraction: tolerate duplication until the third occurrence before extracting
- Comments: explain WHY (decisions, trade-offs), never WHAT
- Logic: every line justifiable from first principles in current context
- Assumptions: encode preconditions as types, guard clauses, or assertions
- Simplicity: default to the plainest, most conventional approach

## Testing

- Run tests: `pnpm run test`

## Git Workflow

- Commit format: `<type>(<change>): <summary>` (imperative mood, <80 chars)
  - Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `test`, `chore`, `refactor`, `perf`
  - `<change>`: active grspec change name (omit for unscoped work)
  - Examples:
    - `feat(agents-md-v2): add tech stack detection`
    - `test(agents-md-v2): add generator edge cases`
    - `docs(agents-md-v2): update design with new approach`
    - `chore: archive agents-md-v2`
- Branch from `main`, prefix with `feat/`, `fix/`, or `chore/`
- Before committing: `pnpm run lint && pnpm run test`
- Squash merge PRs

### Commit Scope by File Type

| When you...                    | git add                                   | Commit type  |
|-------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|--------------|
| Implement a plan item          | `src/` + `test/` (modified files)         | `feat`/`fix` |
| Create/update grspec artifacts | `grspec/changes/<name>/`                  | `docs`       |
| Archive a change               | `grspec/specs/` + `grspec/changes/<name>` | `chore`      |
| Update project config          | `AGENTS.md`, `.cursor/`, `package.json`   | `chore`      |

## Boundaries

- ✅ **Always:**
  - Run `pnpm run lint` before committing
  - Run `pnpm run test` before committing
  - Verify `pnpm run build` succeeds
- ⚠️ **Ask first:**
  - Database schema changes
  - Adding new dependencies
  - Modifying CI/CD config
- 🚫 **Never:**
  - Commit secrets or API keys
  - Force push to main/master
  - Delete test files to make tests pass
  - Skip type checks or linting to proceed

## grspec Workflow

This project uses grspec for spec-driven development.
- Specs: `grspec/specs/` — behavioral requirements (current truth)
- Changes: `grspec/changes/` — active change proposals with delta specs
- Format: `### Requirement:` / `#### Scenario:` structured specs
- Workflow: propose → specs → design → ui → plan → implement → verify → archive
